author: Forbes
description:
At just 30 years-old, Luana Lopes Lara has achieved what most founders only dream of: she is the world's youngest female self-made billionaire and the cofounder of Kalshi, a regulated prediction market platform that is currently seeing up to $4 billion in trading volume a week. In this episode hosted by Maggie McGrath, she explains the pivotal moment the company decided to sue the U.S. government to legalize election betting (and won), how her grueling training as a Bolshoi ballerina prepared her for the intense, grueling hours of startup life and why the platform is now aggressively expanding into perpetual futures to disrupt traditional finance.

author: Forbes
description:
In 1967, Shahid "Shad" Khan stepped into a historic Midwest blizzard with melting shoes and only $500 to his name. Today, the Pakistan-born immigrant is a billionaire auto-parts magnate and one of the first immigrant owners of an NFL franchise, the Jacksonville Jaguars.

How did a college student washing dishes to survive manage to build a multi-billion-dollar manufacturing empire? In this exclusive Forbes profile, Khan opens up about his incredible journey and the resilience required to achieve the American Dream. He shares the early hurdles of trying to find a job without a green card, the sobering realities of post-9/11 discrimination, and the surprising reason why he still carries his passport to the grocery store today.

2:34 The Green Card Dilemma & Bumper Works 
05:25 The New Face of Manufacturing 
10:56 Burden Of The Immigrant Experience
12:12 The Current State Of The American Dream
